step1_analysis.description: The circuit is a cross-coupled CMOS latch that functions as an active-low SR latch. The precharge PMOS transistors act as SET and RESET inputs, while the cross-coupled inverters hold the state. Due to missing bulk connections in the extracted netlist (a common issue with non-standard bulk-input extraction), it operates as a standard latch rather than a bulk-input differential logic gate.

paper_reference.title: Design and Application of CMOS Bulk Input Scheme

delay_set.description: Propagation delay from /SET (LABEL_NET_0) falling to N0 rising

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay depends on PMOS pull-up strength and load capacitance. With W=5u and L=0.5u, the delay should be very small.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Large W/L ratio provides strong drive current, leading to fast switching times in the picosecond range.

delay_reset.description: Propagation delay from /RESET (LABEL_NET_2) falling to N1 rising

power_dynamic.description: Average power consumption during switching events (measured as average current)

sky130_expected.calculation: P = C * V^2 * f. With small internal capacitance, power is dominated by short-circuit current during switching.
sky130_expected.reasoning: At 1.8V in SKY130, dynamic current for a single latch switching at ~100MHz equivalent rate is in the 100uA range.

power_static.description: Static leakage power in hold state

sky130_expected.calculation: Leakage current of OFF transistors (PMOS and NMOS) multiplied by VDD.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard threshold devices in SKY130 have low leakage, typically sub-nA per micron of width.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure SET/RESET propagation delays and power consumption of the latch.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Latch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VSET LABEL_NET_0 0 PULSE(1.8 0 1n 50p 50p 1n 10n)
VRESET LABEL_NET_2 0 PULSE(1.8 0 4n 50p 50p 1n 10n)
VBIAS LABEL_NET_3 0 1.8
VDUMMY1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0
VDUMMY4 LABEL_NET_4 0 0

XM1 N1 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 GND LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 N1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 N0 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N3 LABEL_NET_3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 GND GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N2 VDD GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 GND LABEL_NET_4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

.ic v(N0)=0 v(N1)=1.8

.control
  * DC Operating Point for static power
  op
  let p_stat = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print p_stat

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 8n
  
  * Measure delays
  meas tran delay_set trig v(LABEL_NET_0) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 rise=1
  meas tran delay_reset trig v(LABEL_NET_2) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1
  
  * Measure dynamic current (multiply by 1.8V for power)
  meas tran i_avg avg i(VVDD) from=0 to=8n
  
  quit
.endc
